hero.name: Example Hero
hero.desc: <color=#FFD700>Role Ability</color>. Placeholder: no ability is wired, so this perk grants nothing.

perks.name: Steady Hand
perks.desc: While manning a <color=#FFD700>System Module</color>, its <color=#FFD700>Accuracy</color> is increased.

perks.name: Tough Hull
perks.desc: While manning any <color=#FFD700>System Module</color>, the ship's <color=#FFD700>Shield Absorption</color> is increased.

perks.name: Extra Lock
perks.desc: The ship can hold one more <color=#FFD700>Target Lock</color> while you man a system.

perks.name: Fleet Shields
perks.desc: Every ship on your side has its <color=#FFD700>Shield Absorption</color> increased. The bonus is shared among them: one ship gets all of it, three ships a third each.

perks.name: Boarding Drill
perks.desc: While aboard an <color=#FFD700>enemy ship</color>, you accelerate faster.
